description: Build and host full-stack apps using your own ChatGPT subscription. No AI build credits required. Floot MCP Server exposes the entire platform as native ChatGPT tool calls: create a project, write code, provision a database, enable auth, manage file storage, and deploy, all from a single conversation. Your ChatGPT subscription does the building. Floot handles the infrastructure. One conversation in, one working, hosted app out.
